description: Weekly, minor and patch grouped, each release at least 7 days old (security fixes excepted). Majors and 0.x minors (cargo) are held back. Lock files only (D5 in devlog/v1.3.x-ci-cd.md). Flutter, Rust, frb, gogdl-lib and the local CI image move by hand, together with Lumen (D4).

lockFileMaintenance.description: Off: it runs a plain `cargo update`, which bypasses the 7-day age check for every transitive crate.

packageRules.description: Lumen builds this rust/Cargo.lock and resolves its own pubspec.lock: update the lock files only, never raise a floor in Cargo.toml or pubspec.yaml (D5).
Pin CI and Dockerfile images by digest; digest updates then come in a grouped MR.
Semver-major updates are done by hand.
A 0.x minor is a breaking change: treat it as a major.
One MR for all minor, patch and digest updates.

The CI image's base is its own MR: the image is shared with Lumen. Bump IMAGE_REVISION in ci/build-image.sh, rebuild on the runner host, and push the new image: in .gitlab-ci.yml onto the branch. Lumen moves in its own MR.
